## What I Do

### Data Analytics

I clean, validate, aggregate, and analyse operational and financial datasets using Python, Pandas, Jupyter Notebook, SQL, Excel, and Power Query.

### Business Intelligence

I build Power BI dashboards that integrate multiple business dimensions and improve reporting visibility for management.

### Financial & Process Transformation

I have led financial-system implementation and workflow digitalisation projects covering budgeting, reimbursement, accounting, reconciliation, and management reporting.

## Current Focus

I am particularly interested in roles at the intersection of:

- Data and business analytics
- Financial analytics and controlling
- Supply-chain and operations analytics
- Business intelligence
- Cloud FinOps and cost optimisation
- AI-enabled business processes
